subject: general
question: Which of the following substances experiences the least change in shape when subjected to a change in pressure?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Solid**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Solids have a definite shape and volume, and their particles are closely packed in a fixed arrangement.
 
• Due to the strong intermolecular forces between particles, solids are highly resistant to deformation under pressure.
 
• When subjected to pressure, the particles in a solid can only move slightly, resulting in minimal change in shape.
 
• Compared to liquids, gases, and plasma, solids maintain their structure and exhibit the least compressibility.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Liquids**

 
 
• Liquids have a definite volume but no definite shape, taking the shape of their container.
 
• The intermolecular forces in liquids are weaker than in solids, allowing particles to move past one another.
 
• Liquids are more compressible than solids but less compressible than gases.
 
 
 
• **Gases**
 
 
• Gases have neither a definite shape nor a definite volume and expand to fill their container.
 
• The particles in gases are far apart and move freely, resulting in high compressibility.
 
• Gases experience significant changes in shape and volume under pressure.
 
 
 
• **Plasma**
 
 
• Plasma is an ionized state of matter consisting of free electrons and ions.
 
• It has properties distinct from solids, liquids, and gases, including high electrical conductivity.
 
• Plasma can change shape easily and is highly responsive to electromagnetic fields.
